query:
query ExternalCaptureBootstrap {
  externalCapture {
    responsibilityId
    recaptureRequestId
    status
    confirmationOnly
    kind
    disclosureVersion
    reference
    policy
    referenceItems {
      mediaId
      requirementKey
      description
      availability
      imageUrl
      imageUrlExpiresAt
    }
    requirements {
      key
      section
      label
      instructions
      required
      minimumMedia
      maximumMedia
      descriptionRequired
      captureSourcePolicy
      comparisonTarget
      impossibilityAllowed
    }
    answers {
      requirementKey
      mediaIds
      impossibilityReason
      version
    }
  }
}
